entities.summary: Shi Shen was a Chinese astronomer and astrologer born in the State of Wei, who lived from unknown to 400 BCE. He was a contemporary of Gan De and made significant contributions to the field of astronomy, including the development of the Chinese calendar. Shi Shen's work had a lasting impact on Chinese culture and was passed down through generations, influencing the development of later astronomical systems. His legacy can be seen in the continued use of the Chinese calendar and the importance of astronomical observations in Chinese culture. As the first recorded Chinese astronomer, Shi Shen's work laid the foundation for later Chinese astronomical achievements.
